collection.title: Meneer Internal Engineering RAG
collection.description: Retrieval routing for the audited v1 repository, confirmed product direction, technical debt, and future migration planning.

rules: Separate observed implementation from owner-confirmed direction and proposals.
Do not treat this collection as clinical, legal, or patient-facing guidance.
Do not ingest secrets, credentials, patient data, local environment files, or generated build output.
Use authoritative source documents for material decisions; use RAG documents for routing and synthesis.
Close every sprint with a completion report plus synchronized plan, debt, RAG, and index updates.
